# Copilot instructions

Read and follow the repository's canonical contributor guidance in
[../AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) before working. It covers requirements-first
changes, architecture, privacy, validation, and completion expectations. If
any instruction here appears inconsistent, follow `AGENTS.md`.

For cross-domain reviews, read [agents/README.md](../agents/README.md), the
panel protocol and shared review contract. Keep reviews read-only and designate
one edit owner. [Native surface guidance](../agents/native-surfaces.md)
documents cloud/VS Code differences, sequential fallback and artifact-based
Claude-to-Copilot continuation. Native `panel-*` profiles are installed in
`.github/agents/`; inspect actual capabilities before using their research tools.
